Why are we doing this?

Turn AI curiosity into the confidence to build

Vibe coding points toward a future of describing intent and building with AI. Companies are shaping it through assistants and agents. Learning to guide and verify their work matters more than learning another "magic prompt."

Why this workshop existsWhat you gain
Watching demos is not the same as buildingPractice changing, testing and explaining real software
Your experience deserves more than a static resumeA portfolio grounded in your own evidence
Useful AI needs more than a chat windowConnect UI, authentication, APIs and validated output
Faster output is not automatically trustworthyJudgment about facts, privacy, errors and quality

The goal is not to depend on AI. It is to become more capable with it.
